body:
## QA pass kit is on the release branch

`docs/QA_REVIEW_PASS.md` (PR #73, merged to `release/v1.2.0-staging`) now has:

- **Demo scenarios**: Settings → QA / Demo Data → Scenario A (newbie) or B (cut).
- **Route checklist**: home/nav, weight (1/2/5+ circles), frequency (accessories tap-to-log), ladder, total work, custom programs, stats tabs + Bodyweight Trend, history view/edit/delete, diet (macros, body measurements, food search), settings (skins/levels/targets/backups), forum/store.
- **Cross-cutting checks**: contrast on Iron & Bone + Chalk & Steel, empty states, orientation, 1.3x text scale, overnight rollover proof, backup round-trip.
- **Known limitations**: rollover device proof outstanding, iOS pass not run this cycle, Flutter 3.50 `material_ui` migration filed as follow-up, no barcode scanning, no cloud sync.
- **Sign-off table** for Umer/Ryan.

### Already verified this cycle (Redmi 23090RA98G, Android 16)
| Area | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Contrast (dark + light) | screenshots `72-stats-iron`, `80-frequency-light` |
| Weight 1/2/5+ + NEXT | `92/93/94/95` |
| Frequency accessories + planks seconds | `06-planks-logged`, `115-dips-logged` |
| History edit + delete (Stats recalcs) | `103-109` |
| Scenario A/B import + Stats | `101`, `102` |
| Diet search + add item | `111/112` |
| Body measurements add/edit/delete + trend | `121-125` |

Suggested next step: Ryan runs the checklist against a fresh install, files any failures as issues, then merges #43.
